views.front: The refined warm ceramic base and hollow linen shade retain the original lamp proportions with smoother outlines.
views.rear: The opposite side shows a continuous tapered shade and seated brass neck without the original coarse banding.
views.detail: The shade fabric is restrained at this scale and the base-to-neck transition is clean.
views.underside: The underside exposes actual shade lining and support spokes around the socket, with a closed ceramic base.
views.clay: Clay confirms the open shade and smoother turned base are construction improvements rather than only surface changes.
